# #1849: Patch: combat and replacement verbs for Stinkyscape
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Phase 0 of the Stinkyscape set: a mechanic merged on `main` without the set. No card reaches it until fullsend 1 ships the set; its Stinkyscape cards are built later, in S15, S16.

## The verbs

Each with the Stinkyscape card that uses it:

- **Immune to Spell Damage** (#74 Paragon-X), a keyword narrower than Immune to Spells.
- **Evolve, and "after this attacks, summon a copy of it"** (#91 The Propagation's Wasp, #92 The Propagation's Hornet: "Evolve: gain Flying").
- **Destroy becomes exile** (#105 Disintegrex), for every card or, on its Radiant face, the enemy's permanents.
- **Damage this takes is also dealt to the enemy hero**, and on the Radiant face to the attacker (#104 Reflective Plating).
- **Your own-turn damage redirected to your opponent, with a cap per turn** (#5 Masochism Unmasked: 20, doubled up to 40 on the Radiant face).
- **The Gauntlet's lanes** (#157 The Gauntlet): the Units of the middle three lanes target only each other, and no other Unit targets them.
- **"When the enemy summons a Unit, a random Unit of yours attacks it"**, or every Unit (#23 Warp Disruptor, #24 Warp Disruptor II), and **"Units can't be in Defense Position"** as an aura.
- **"When one of your Taunt Units is attacked"** (#14 Arm of the Jempire).
- **A trap with a chance to reveal** (#174 Aerelret, #22 Gatinsir: 30% when an opponent attacks).

## Done when

- Each verb is an engine primitive (`crates/engine`), proved on fixture scripts (`crates/engine/tests/rules/fixtures/`, the `testkit`'s `scenario()`), its edges included. No Stinkyscape card is needed or added: the cards come later, behind the set's gate.
- Its §6 row (and §4 where it touches combat), and ruling notes from this issue's block, R(N×1000) up, each named after its proving test (CLAUDE.md rule 3); `cargo jackioh spec index` and `cargo jackioh spec check`.
- A new event has its `ANIMATIONS` and `SOUND_CUES` rows; a new prompt or action is answered by `crates/ai`, the random policy and the timeout, and `legalActions`, the reducer's refusal and the view agree.
- New state is optional and skipped when absent, so no shipped game changes: no golden trace moves and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main` names no card that plays differently (plan D3).
- Every number is a named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9) and the pure crates stay pure (rule 4).
- The gates: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check`, `fuzz --seeds 200`, and the web's typecheck and tests where the client changed.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy/docs/stinkyscape-set.md) (ST3, ST5); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy/JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy` until they merge; where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md).

Part of #1836.

**Goal.** Build the nine Stinkyscape M15 verbs as engine primitives in `crates/engine` (`docs/stinkyscape-set.md` ST3 M15, on `origin/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy`). Each is proved on fixture scripts and gets one ruling note (R1849000–R1849009) and its spec rows. The verbs:

- Destroy becomes exile, for every card or only the enemy's.
- Damage this takes is also dealt to the enemy hero, and to the attacker.

- The Gauntlet's lanes.
- "Units can't be in Defense Position" as an aura, and "a random Unit of yours attacks it".

**Decisions the task left open (Hearthstone reading; each rejected alternative goes in its note):**
- **R1849000:**
  - The whole hit is negated before Divine Shield, which stays.
  - A Spell's Trample excess is stopped too.
  - Spells may still target the Unit. Rejected: blocking the targeting as well.
- **R1849001:**
  - "Evolve: X" runs only when an effect evolves the unit.
  - The copy is summoned first, so it lacks what the evolve gives.
  - Rejected: Hearthstone's transform into a random Unit that costs (1) more.
- **R1849002:**
  - What is destroyed is what the state check collects. Sacrifices, discards and a spent Trap are not.
  - The aura card exiles itself on the base face.
  - Exiled cards trigger no Death, no Reborn and no `destroyed`.
- **R1849003:**
  - The reflected hits are new instances from this Unit.
  - "The attacker" means only the attacker's own strike, Cleave included, so nothing loops.
- **R1849004:**
